substitution_policy: Each row is one runtime identity. A different OpenFOAM variant, version, platform, image digest or executable hash is a different row, never the same runtime. Gates bind rows and fields explicitly; an attestation that substitutes any of them is refused. OpenCFD v2406 is the only runtime with historical turbo evidence; the OpenFOAM Foundation 13 and 14 images named in the general toolchain documentation are not interchangeable with it.
availability_rule: Availability is recorded per host and date. A host this inventory could not reach is unknown, never assumed present or absent.

rows.turbo_role: The only runtime carrying historical turbo evidence: meshing pilots, MRF witnesses, case 084 and the 052/053 parity control.

evidence.claim: The official v2406 source revisions 630d60de and be01ca78 differ by zero files; this matches sources, not compiled binaries.

cfd/prepare_case.py writes writePrecision 12; later witnesses rewrite that single entry to writePrecision 16. A new case generated with prepare_case.py unchanged would violate the retained writePrecision 16.
